# Third-Party Legal Materials

This directory collects third-party runtime and dependency license notes used
for FrameLean release packages.

For the current product scope, the most important media release component is
FEngine statically linked with the bundled libav SDK built with x264 and zimg
enabled. No ffmpeg / ffprobe executables are packaged. Direct Dart package
licenses are summarized in ../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
